messages:
kai.design: quick thread / new compact-row latency mock attached. main dilemma: surface sampling inline under the heatmap scrubber (one-tap) or keep toolbar minimal and move it into the kebab menu?

ara.eng: inline is more discoverable. dev caveat: our prefs are dashboard-level; per-chart persistence requires a schema change. prototype shows ~20ms extra render if we read per-chart prefs.

mike.pm: users keep asking if sampling changes p95. microcopy must make the distinction: short line like 'Sampling thins visual points. Metrics (p50/p95) remain full-accuracy unless you enable "Lower metrics precision."'

hana.a11y: accessibility checklist: funnel icon needs aria-label='Open sampling options for Heatmap'; popover role=dialog, trap focus, dismiss on Escape and click-away; switch should have aria-describedby pointing to the help text. Slider needs aria-valuemin='5', aria-valuemax='100', aria-valuenow and aria-live='polite'. Do not rely on color alone to indicate state; add text "Sampling: On" when active.

ara.eng: viable compromise: keep global toggle in toolbar, show a 24px inline funnel for per-chart overrides that opens a small popover with On/Off + slider (step=5) + breadcrumb 'Applies to: Heatmap'. Persist per-chart only behind feature flag 'feature:per_chart_sampling'.

kai.design: love the hybrid. i'll update mock and shorten help copy as mike suggested. will add contrast spec for p95 pill (default #a48ff8 on dark) and a short a11y checklist.

tickets-bot: created ticket #5077 'Hybrid inline funnel + toolbar toggle for sampling (a11y + telemetry)' assigned to ara.eng, due 2024-10-01.
